## Summary

- What changed?
- Why now?

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] CLI behavior checked for affected command(s)
- [ ] Docs/examples updated (if output or UX changed)

## MaintainerFlow guardrails

- [ ] Change remains deterministic and transparent
- [ ] No external paid API dependency added for core features
- [ ] Language stays assistive (no autonomous-review claims)
- [ ] If heuristics changed, tests were added/updated in same PR
- [ ] If user-facing output changed, `docs/examples/` reflects it
